name: Barbell good morning
cue: Bar on the upper back, soft knees, push the hips back until the torso nears parallel, stand tall.

name: Pendlay row
cue: Torso parallel to the floor, row the bar from a dead stop to the lower chest, return it to the floor each rep.

name: Trap bar deadlift
cue: Stand in the middle of the bar, hips back, chest up, push the floor away and stand tall.

name: Barbell split squat
cue: Bar on the back, staggered stance, drop the back knee straight down, drive up through the front foot.

name: Barbell box squat
cue: Sit back to the box, pause without relaxing, drive up through mid-foot.

name: Landmine press
cue: Bar end at the shoulder, press up and forward to lockout, ribs down.

name: Barbell shrug
cue: Arms long, lift the shoulders straight up to the ears, pause, lower slowly.

name: Arnold press
cue: Start palms facing you at the chest, rotate out as you press overhead, reverse on the way down.

name: Dumbbell split squat
cue: Dumbbells at the sides, staggered stance, back knee straight down, drive up through the front foot.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cue: Weight in the opposite hand, hinge on one leg, back leg reaches long, hips square.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
cue: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on the hips, drive up to a straight line, chin tucked.

name: Chest-supported row
cue: Chest on an incline bench, row both dumbbells to the hips, squeeze the shoulder blades.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
cue: Lie back on an incline bench, arms hanging, curl without moving the elbows forward.

name: Dumbbell shrug
cue: Dumbbells at the sides, shoulders straight up to the ears, pause, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell calf raise
cue: Balls of the feet on a step, lower the heels fully, rise as high as you can, pause at the top.

name: Suitcase carry
cue: One heavy dumbbell at one side, stand tall without leaning, walk with short even steps.

name: Goblet reverse lunge
cue: Weight at the chest, step back, back knee toward the floor, drive through the front foot to stand.

name: Kettlebell windmill
cue: Bell locked out overhead, eyes on it, push the hip out and slide the free hand down the front leg.

name: Kettlebell halo
cue: Hold the bell by the horns, circle it close around the head, ribs down, both directions.

name: Kettlebell single-leg deadlift
cue: Bell in the opposite hand, hinge on one leg, back leg long, hips square, stand tall.

name: Kettlebell suitcase carry
cue: One bell at one side, stand tall without leaning, walk with short even steps.

name: Kettlebell high pull
cue: Swing, then pull the bell to chest height with the elbow high and back, let it drop back into the hinge.

name: Cable fly
cue: Pulleys at shoulder height, slight elbow bend, hug the handles together in front of the chest.

name: Cable curl
cue: Low pulley, elbows pinned at the sides, curl to the shoulders, lower slowly.

name: Cable lateral raise
cue: Low pulley across the body, raise the arm out to shoulder height, lead with the elbow.

name: Cable woodchop
cue: Arms long, rotate through the hips and trunk from high to low across the body, control the return.

name: Cable pull-through
cue: Rope between the legs, hinge back, snap the hips forward to stand, squeeze the glutes.

name: Cable glute kickback
cue: Ankle strap on, slight forward lean, kick the leg straight back without arching the low back.

name: Pec deck
cue: Elbows soft at chest height, bring the pads together, squeeze, open slowly.

name: Hack squat
cue: Back flat on the pad, lower until the thighs pass parallel, drive up through the whole foot.

name: Hip abduction machine
cue: Sit tall, push the knees out against the pads, pause, return slowly.

name: Hip adduction machine
cue: Sit tall, squeeze the knees together against the pads, pause, open slowly.

name: Band pull-apart
cue: Arms straight at shoulder height, pull the band apart to the chest, squeeze the shoulder blades.

name: Band row
cue: Band anchored at chest height, row the handles to the ribs, elbows close, squeeze the shoulder blades.

name: Banded lateral walk
cue: Band above the knees, half squat, step sideways keeping tension, toes forward.

name: Band-assisted pull-up
cue: Band looped on the bar under a knee or foot, pull the chest to the bar, lower under control.

name: Bird dog
cue: On all fours, reach the opposite arm and leg long, hips level, pause, return without rocking.

name: Copenhagen plank
cue: Side plank with the top leg on a bench, bottom leg free, hips high in a straight line.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
cue: One foot flat, other leg up, drive the hips up level, squeeze at the top.

name: Pike push-up
cue: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the head between the hands, press back up.

name: Decline push-up
cue: Feet on a bench, body in a straight line, chest to the floor, press up.

name: Incline push-up
cue: Hands on a bench or box, body in a straight line, chest to the edge, press away.

name: Negative pull-up
cue: Jump or step to chin over the bar, lower yourself as slowly as you can to a dead hang.

name: Scapular pull-up
cue: Dead hang, arms straight, pull the shoulder blades down and back to lift the body a few centimetres.

name: Hollow rock
cue: Hold the hollow position, low back pressed down, rock from shoulders to hips without breaking the shape.

name: L-sit
cue: Hands on parallettes or a bench, press down, lift straight legs to horizontal, hold.

name: 90/90 hip switch
cue: Seated with both knees bent to 90°, rotate the knees side to side, tall spine.

name: World's greatest stretch
cue: Lunge, hand inside the front foot, elbow to the instep, rotate and reach the arm to the ceiling.

name: Ab wheel rollout
cue: From the knees, roll out with a flat back as far as you can hold, pull back with the abs.

name: Battle ropes
cue: Athletic half squat, alternate the arms fast to send waves to the anchor, keep the core braced.
